# Matthew Harless

> Writer, speaker and registered nurse in Covington, Indiana, with nearly twenty years at the bedside (psychiatric units, emergency departments, med-surg and hospital resource teams). Speaks to nursing schools, hospital leaders, faith communities and coalitions about moral injury, hope-informed care and the systemic roots of the nursing workforce crisis.

## Work
- Author: How Healthcare Dies: And How Hope Brings It Back to Life; Transition to Care: A Guide for New Nurses
- Host of The Moral Injury Hour, a live weekly conversation and podcast
- Co-founder of The Business of Hope (HopeAssessment.org) with Ashley Chancellor
- Creator of The Harless Method
